_help: 'What we do' cards. 'icon' must be one of: PenTool, LayoutDashboard, Workflow, AppWindow. 'items' are the bullet points shown when a card is opened. 'extras' are the three small boxes under the cards; a body can be plain text or a list of parts, where a part with 'href' becomes a link.
title: What we do
subline: Everything you need to take an idea from sketch to live, in one team. Click a card to see what is inside.

cards.title: Product Design and Branding
cards.description: Your logo, brand identity and product screens, designed so your business looks credible from day one.

cards.title: Business Management Systems
cards.description: Custom tools to run your business: sales, inventory, bookings, invoices and reporting in one place.

cards.title: Digital Transformation and Automation
cards.description: Move from paper and spreadsheets to online systems, and automate repetitive tasks so your team saves time.
items: Moving paper or spreadsheet processes online

cards.title: Web and Mobile Apps
cards.description: Websites, web apps and mobile apps, from a first working version (MVP) to a full product.
items: MVP builds from sketch to launch

extras.title: Included in every project:
extras.body: Project management, quality testing and post-launch support.

extras.title: Also available: QA and testing:
extras.body: Already have an app or website? We test it for bugs, usability and performance, and give you a clear report.

body.text: and we will work it out together.
